categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Time.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via time.fun.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: MMO
categories.content: Online games that host large numbers of players.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Robinhood Chain Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Prediction Market Tools
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies representing projects that function as an application or tooling layer on top of decentralized prediction markets (like Polymarket, Kalshi etc.) to offer enhanced utilities. These platforms do not offer their own prediction bets and markets and instead leverages the liquidity, data, and settlement mechanisms of underlying prediction markets to provide enhanced user experiences, such as trading terminals, copy-trading bots, parlay engines, or social betting interfaces.

categories.name: Commodities Meme
categories.content: Meme projects tied to commodities in traditional finance.

categories.name: Bittensor Subnets
categories.content: Subnets on Bittensor are specialized mini-networks dedicated to specific AI tasks. In each subnet, models (miners) compete to produce high-quality outputs, and their performance is evaluated by validators who assign rankings and allocate TAO rewards accordingly.

categories.name: Decentralized Identifier (DID)
categories.content: Decentralized Identifier (DID) allows individuals or entities to create and manage their own identifiers independently of any centralized registry, identity provider, or intermediary.

categories.name: Augmented Reality
categories.content: Augmented Reality (AR) offers interactive experiences without disconnecting users from the real world, allowing them to interact with digital elements in a real-world context.

categories.name: Optimism Superchain Ecosystem
categories.content: The Optimism Superchain is a unified network of chains built using the open-source OP Stack. This framework provides a standardized, modular architectural framework for creating Layer 2 chains that share a common security and communication layer.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: Pump Fund Portfolio
categories.content: Projects and tokens officially backed by Pump Fund, the venture arm of Pump.fun. These projects are selected for their adherence to "build in public" principles, transparent development, and verified founder commitment.

categories.name: Tap to Earn
categories.content: Tap-to-earn (T2E) combines simple and addictive gameplay with the potential to earn cryptocurrency. These games, often hosted on platforms like Telegram, allow users to earn digital assets by performing actions such as repeatedly tapping on a screen.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Clanker Ecosystem
categories.content: Clanker Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via Clanker, an autonomous memecoin launcher.

categories.name: x402 Ecosystem
categories.content: x402 is an open protocol that defines an internet-native micropayment rail using HTTP 402 and stablecoins. It allows automated clients and AI agents to pay directly for APIs, data, and compute on demand, enabling real-time, low-friction transactions without intermediaries.

categories.name: TimeFi
categories.content: TimeFi is a blockchain-based approach to treating time as a monetizable asset through tokenized productivity, verifiable commitments, and AI-driven incentives.
